WITH invoice_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    SUM(derived_product_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS product_cost_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  WHERE invoice_number IS NOT NULL
    AND derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL
    AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    product_cost_ratio,
    line_item_count,
    product_cost_ratio / NULLIF(AVG(product_cost_ratio) OVER (), 0) AS relative_ratio
  FROM invoice_ratios
)
SELECT invoice_number, product_cost_ratio, line_item_count, relative_ratio
FROM scored
WHERE relative_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: An invoice's ratio is the sum of its line-item product costs divided by the sum of its line-item total costs; line-item count includes only rows with both cost values present, and a zero total cost produces no ratio. The overall average is the unweighted average of the resulting invoice ratios.
